> and so attempting to load it in the current version of the editor (4.5 beta 2 and earlier) fails because the last `)` character is omitted.

There's another bug, too. `Parser Error: Expected opening "(" after function name.`
Or it's a compatibility issue. (Editor <-> Template)

Create a custom template from `master` branch and use it with `Godot 4.5 beta 1` (beta 2 not tested). 

Is there a bug fix for export templates? 

![Bildschirmfoto 2025-07-06 um 14 03 02](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61a8adec-4503-4fde-8ef0-ee03862baf33)

It used to be fine _(I was able to use 4.3 and 4.4 stable with custom `master` templates)_, but for about three weeks now,
I've been seeing this error repeatedly, and I also have to recompile Godot Editor. (master branch)
